system.description:
Artificial replacements for sight, hearing, touch or taste, or entirely new senses. Common versions are clearly artificial and roughly match human senses, with no further effect.

Poor: -2k0 on Tests that use the sense. Good: grants Heightened Senses for that sense and +2k0 on Tests to resist attacks on it, such as blinding flashes or deafening noise. Extras such as telescopic sight, a photo-visor, darksight or a built-in micro-bead are each paid for as a separate implant. Best adds no further benefit beyond Good.
system.effectText: Poor: -2k0 tests with that sense. Good: Heightened Senses for it and +2k0 vs attacks on it; extras cost separately.
